horoscope: Try not to rush matters to a quick conclusion due to impatience early today, dear Aries. With the Moon in your private twelfth house for much of the day, you instinctively withdraw from challenging or demanding situations. You may be seeking some alone time or extra rest. However, truly relaxing early in the day can be difficult, and demanding people or circumstances may very well find you! Watch for jumping ahead of yourself, and in the process, creating unnecessary tension. While your spirit of discovery is active and will continue to motivate you for many weeks, you may also need some time alone to sort out your feelings and experiences. The Moon moves into your sign later today, and emotions need clear channels for expression. You're especially inclined to reach out to others for acknowledgment and reinforcement.

There is a natural need to detach yourself temporarily from people and situations that have recently added stress or pressure to your life, dear Taurus. Even so, the Moon forms a square to Mars early today, and you can feel blocked from pursuing some of your desires. The Moon is stirring a need to let go of pressure and unwind in good company, but a reminder of an expense, a money concern, or a feeling of missing out could temporarily undermine this pursuit. Give thought to your finances and how you can make meaningful changes that free you from worry. You would do well to conserve energy until you have the confidence to go full speed ahead. Later today, the Moon moves into your solar twelfth house, and you'll do well to take a pause from your busy schedule and allow yourself to enjoy the moment. Or, if you need it, this can be a time to cocoon, rest, and reflect. You can feel very much in need of calm.

Your responsibilities and reputation are prominent in your mind today, dear Gemini. While you should concern yourself with what others expect of you to some degree now with the Moon at the top of your chart for much of today, there is no need to overdo this beyond what you can do at the moment. Try to turn competition or criticism around by using it to fuel your motivation to improve. In truth, with Mars in your sign these days, you feel compelled to explore or assert your independence, such that finding a balance makes the most sense. As the day moves forward, however, a friend or cherished goal can help you gain some perspective. The Moon heads into your solar eleventh house, and you crave more recreation.

This morning, there can be a tendency to be quick on the trigger when it comes to speaking or communicating, dear Cancer. Watch for hypersensitivity and quick reactions when patience will serve you far better. Avoid juggling, as this can lead to mistakes. As the day advances, your more unique qualities stand out pleasantly, and you can be feeling rather inspired. You may also feel some pressure, largely of the good, motivating kind, to take care of business, take the lead, and perform at your best. It's a good time for cleaning up your act, so to speak, as you are a little more ambitious than usual. You may not have things handed to you today, as you're more likely to need to work for your rewards, but it can be quite satisfying doing so.

Early today, it's best to avoid jumping to conclusions, dear Leo. With a Moon-Mars clash, we're inclined to take things more personally than is probably warranted. You can be a little secretive or protective of your plans and feelings, and that's quite normal at this time of the lunar month. It may be that you need to gather up your energy and think more carefully before going forward with important projects. Work on emotional self-control today, but do listen to what your feelings are telling you. Certainly, you can feel a little torn between your genuine needs for some introspection or attention to important matters and your social demands or inclinations. As the day advances, you're interested in getting out and about or more actively involved in life as a participant rather than an observer.

With Mars in your solar fourth house, dear Virgo, it's best to confront your fears about past matters so that you'll be better equipped to handle them if they do reappear in your life. Your larger focus for much of the day is to foster a sense of balance and peace with others, but early today, there can be some frustrating trial and error getting to this point. Because it's currently a tall order, don't get down on yourself if you can't quite achieve it. If you feel too dependent on others' schedules, plans, and needs, take steps to change this, but keep in mind that it will take time. As the day advances, there's a good feeling of forward motion. At the same time, you are a little more serious, and you stay away from anything that seems too superficial. Doing one or two things well, instead of many things satisfactorily, is most rewarding now.

Early today, there can be a tendency to rush something or to succumb to pressures to get far too much done in a short period, dear Libra. The Moon in your work and health sector has you seeing the problems or flaws in your life, which can be helpful in some ways. However, its square to Mars is impatient energy. It can be challenging to focus, and this comes down to feeling torn between the desire for more life experience and the need to straighten out details. It's better to put some order in your daily affairs before moving your bigger plans ahead, and you're ready to accept this as the day advances. Later today, however, the mood changes as the Moon moves into your solar seventh house. This is a more sociable, engaged transit. Cooperation comes more readily.

With the Moon in your solar fifth house for much of the day, dear Scorpio, you may be looking for positive feedback, and it's important to try not to invest too much feeling into this, especially since the energies of early today are up and down. People seem a bit preoccupied at best and tense and self-focused at worst. This is due to a Moon-Mars square that's temporary but can also stir things up. You might feel a little torn between applying yourself to a challenging project or problem and enjoying some fun time. You might waver between trusting someone or something, on the one hand, and questioning motives, on the other. Signals can get crossed. The day does smooth out later on, and you may bring some food for thought with you. In fact, as the day advances, you prefer not to be idle, and you're ready to put in the work. The Moon's move to your sector of work and health turns your attention to improving your everyday affairs.

Watch for doing too much early today, dear Sagittarius, particularly if it involves pleasing others who may not fully appreciate all that you do for them at the moment. However, strive to enjoy downtime, as you're in need of a bit of comfort and security. Domestic or internal improvements, changes, and renovations can be in focus. If excess energy is used positively, feeling frustrated with your domestic situation or your emotional life can light a fire under you to get things sorted out. You're on the right road as the day advances. As well, the Moon moves into your sector of joy, and enjoying and expressing yourself is a strong draw.

While there is a tendency to make more of something than it is in the first half of today, dear Capricorn, you may be in a good position to stretch your mind and come up with the motivation to solve problems. The Moon's conflict with Mars early today can point to an equal interest in personal pursuits and duties, but it's important not to overdo either. It can feel very chaotic if you're overreaching, and you can find it difficult to get much done with your attention so divided. Try to tune out some of the extras for the best results. As the day progresses, you may find yourself needing more comfort, familiarity, and quiet, and it's easier to focus with the goal of fulfilling these needs in mind.

With the Moon in your resources sector for much of today, dear Aquarius, you're seeking out a nice dose of predictability. In the first half of the day, though, there can be plenty of interference to navigate, whether it's because a lot is going on around you or because you're dealing with a fear of missing out. There can be some crankiness, mostly related to rushing or impatience to handle needs and desires. You're also especially sensitive to your money situation or sense of security. However, once past this, centering yourself, getting comfortable, and enjoying pleasures come more readily. Still, the Moon later moves into your solar third house, stirring your curiosity. You're more communicative as the day advances.

Aim to be as flexible as possible in the first half of the day, dear Pisces, as difficult as that may be, to avoid letting small things get to you. The Moon in your sign brings unacknowledged feelings to light, which can be illuminating, but with a Moon-Mars square early today, watch for overreaction. Pushing or working too hard could be an issue now, and taking on far too many lofty goals at once can wear on your patience. Your need for independence and forward motion can feel a bit at odds with your desire for some comfort and predictability, but if you pace yourself, you may find ways to attend to both needs in small but satisfying ways. Aim to take undue pressure off yourself now. There's a pleasant splash of creativity or originality in your approach to the world. As the day advances, it's easier to wind down, or wind up in a focused manner, whichever suits your purposes and mood best now.
